notes: Parent Lennox; related Lennox-family brands listed on the page, but the page does not state they share this system, so no sister is claimed and no usesStylesOf is set. This page documents the same four styles, positions and examples as the AirEase page, so the same encoding decisions apply: Style 1 ships year-only (month letter chart image Style-1_Airease-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png held; repo Lennox month table not imported, different chart image file). Page Style 2 is HELD entirely (month 7th position and year 8th position both chart letters, image Style-2_Airease-Date-of-Manufacture_Serial-Number-Nomenclature.png). Page Style 3 ships year-only (month letter chart image Air-Ease-Johnson.png held; day positions 1-2 have no schema field). Page Style 4 ships in full (year digits + week digits, both text-stated).

styles.notes: Page positions 3-4 = year; 5th position = month letter (chart image only, held). Page example shown as 1606 B13871.

styles.era: 10-character serials, day + month letter + 2-digit year + letters + digits (page Style 3)
styles.notes: Page positions 1-2 = day (no schema field, not encoded), 3rd position = month letter (chart image Air-Ease-Johnson.png only, held), 4th-5th positions = year. Page example shown as 15 A 67 JA098.
Page positions 7-8 = year, 9-10 = week. Page example shown as 41407203 28.
